- Agent 1’s compromise was introduced, but Agent 2 did not meaningfully accept or reject that specific compromise logic; the central premises (alternatives effectiveness and sourcing harm) remained contested.

- Undecided: which factual premises are correct (learning equivalence and especially sourcing statistics) and how to properly balance educational benefits against ethical/environmental costs under those facts.
